body.message: Hi! Thanks for the clarification ,that makes sense regarding the 3-month blocks.Since I’m committing to a full 6-month stay through the summer period, I was hoping we could agree on a fixed rate upfront to avoid uncertainty later on. Would the landlord be open to locking in AED 7,000/month all-inclusive for the full April 10 to September 10 period? Given the lower summer demand and a confirmed 6-month commitment, it feels like a fair middle ground.
